gh_json.body:
Closes #2094

## Problem
On a no-remote repo, a rework worker that dies without committing was parked by `local_work_park.park_unpublishable_work` (`agent:review-ready`, `open_passive`). The branch head still equals the verdict's `reviewed_head_sha`, so `_local_review_packets` sees no new head, and `_local_dispatch_rework` selects only `rework_requested`. Nothing picked the issue up again (mdls wedge, 2026-09-29).

## Fix (at the park edge, the single point of enforcement)
New `src/charlie_work/local_noop_rework_rearm.py::rearm_no_op_local_rework`, called from `park_unpublishable_work` before the `local_work_ready` transition. When the branch head equals the local PR record's `reviewed_head_sha` AND the record status is a pending rework (`request_changes`, or `rework_requested` as set by `_route_to_rework` for an approved verdict sent back for conflict/CI), it restores issue+PR status `rework_requested` and applies the `rework_requested` label edge (the same edge `_route_to_rework` uses). It increments the existing `no_op_rework_attempts` counter on the PR record. Once attempts exceed `review.max_no_op_rework_attempts`, it escalates via `_escalate_issue` (reason `no_op_rework_attempts_cap_exceeded`, mechanical) with the matching escalation label edge. Otherwise (head moved, no pending rework, head unresolvable) it returns `None` and the park proceeds exactly as before.

## Invariant enumeration (every exit of `rearm_no_op_local_rework`)
- head unresolvable (`branch_head_sha` is None) -> `None`, normal park (existing tests use non-git dirs and still park).
- no local record with pending rework at this head (worker committed, or no record) -> `None`, normal park.
- attempts <= cap -> state `rework_requested` + label edge; label failure returns `(False, error)` (caller falls to its redispatch cap, same as the park's own failure contract).
- attempts > cap -> `escalated` state + escalation label edge; same failure contract.
- dry-run -> state written through `write_gate`, label transition is a gate no-op, returns `(True, None)`.
No path leaves the issue passive for a no-op rework.

## Tests
`tests/test_local_noop_rework_rearm.py` (real git repo + real `LocalFileGitHub`): request_changes no-commit exit re-arms; approved-then-merge-conflict (#144 shape) re-arms; a worker that committed still parks review-ready (control); repeat is bounded and escalates at the cap.

### Commands run
- `uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_local_noop_rework_rearm.py -q --tb=short` -> 4 passed
- `uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_local_noop_rework_rearm.py tests/test_local_review_ready.py tests/test_orphan_sweep_local_park.py tests/test_orphan_sweep_backstop_local_park.py tests/test_unescalate_local_park.py tests/test_local_issues_merge_gate.py -q --tb=short` -> exit 0, all passed (progress line only, `-q`)
- `uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_file_size_ratchet.py tests/test_dormant_fleet_marking.py tests/test_event_kind_consumers.py -q --tb=short` -> exit 0
- `uv run ruff check .` -> All checks passed; `uv run ruff format --check .` -> 1021 files already formatted
- No public signature/return shape changed, so the full suite was not run locally (CI is the gate).

### Mutation check
Reverted ONLY `src/charlie_work/local_work_park.py` to its merge-base version (drops the call to `rearm_no_op_local_rework`). Run against it:
```
FAILED tests/test_local_noop_rework_rearm.py::test_no_commit_exit_rearms_rework[request_changes-request_changes]
FAILED tests/test_local_noop_rework_rearm.py::test_no_commit_exit_rearms_rework[approved-rework_requested]
FAILED tests/test_local_noop_rework_rearm.py::test_repeat_is_bounded_then_escalates
AssertionError: assert 'open_passive' == 'escalated'
```
(The committed-worker control test passes in both states, as intended.) With the fix restored the 4 tests pass (`4 passed` above).

## Risks / uncertain areas
- The cap reuses the PR record's `no_op_rework_attempts` (reset to 0 by the local lane on each new packet adoption) rather than the issue-level redispatch window; bounded, but a repeated no-commit exit on the same head burns the same counter as the janitor no-op lane.
- `_local_dispatch_rework` still requires `rework-prompt.md`; it was written at the original rework routing and is not recreated here (a missing prompt is already reported as a skip, not silent).
- Registered the new event kind via `src/charlie_work/event_levels/local_no_op_rework_rearmed.level` (`warning`); `tests/test_instrumentation_event_kind_registry.py`, `tests/test_local_noop_rework_rearm.py` and `tests/test_event_kind_consumers.py` pass together (exit 0) at the pushed head.
- Not security-sensitive. New audit event `local_no_op_rework_rearmed` is marked audit-only (state + label are the actionable signal).
gh_json.title: fix(local-lane): re-arm no-commit rework exit instead of parking review-ready
